basic_info.description: 457 8th Avenue a well-maintained eight (8) unit apartment building located between Geary and Anza Streets in San Francisco's Inner Richmond District. Built in 1960, the property features a unit mix of six (6) 1bd/1ba units and two (2) 2bd/1ba units. Amenities include parking for eight (8) cars and on-site laundry. The property is fully occupied, and a soft-story seismic retrofit was completed in 2019. Tenants enjoy close proximity to shops and restaurants along Balboa and Clement Streets and easy access to Golden Gate Park and the Presidio. 457 8th Avenue presents investors the opportunity to acquire a clean, low-maintenance asset in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods.
